_doc: KC Stories daily picks LEDGER — the authoritative dedup source for event-level news repeats. WHY THIS EXISTS: Mixpanel itemID dedup is broken (itemID = slide UUID, not news_id) and chat-history dedup is unreliable. So the daily run WRITES every published ref_id (news_id) here and READS this file before selection to exclude anything used recently. Maintained by the kc-stories-daily routine; see kc-stories-workflow.md Steps 3 + 13.
how_to_use: Before SELECTION: load runs[].picks[].news_id AND runs[].also_shown[].news_id for every run whose date is within dedup_window_days of today; that set = recently_used_news_ids. EXCLUDE any candidate (commodity/FMCG/news, in-house or MP) whose news_id is in that set — auto-swap to the next pool candidate. After PUBLISH: append a new run entry for today with the final published news_ids per tag (and list any picks that were shown then swapped out under also_shown). Keep newest run last. Never delete history; the window filter handles staleness.
